[Rewrite]
# 感谢【可莉】分享
# 发现页面 正在直播
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/webcast-open\.douyin\.com\/webcast\/openapi\/feed\/\?/i then reject_dict(200)
# 播放器界面 - 关联提示语及你关注的人喜欢了
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/beta-luna\.douyin\.com\/luna\/card\?/i then response.json.replace(["card_items[0].priority_display", "card_items[0].is_show", "preview_guide"], [false, false, null])
# 歌曲详情 - 热门视频
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/beta-luna\.douyin\.com\/luna\/more-panel\?/i then response.json.delete("blocks[1]")
# 邀请开通会员弹窗
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/beta-luna\.douyin\.com\/luna\/commerce\/v2\/commerce_info\?/i then reject_dict(200)
# 字节跳动广告
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/ether-pack\.pangolin-sdk-toutiao\.com\/union\/endcard\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api-access\.pangolin-sdk-toutiao\d?\.com\/api\/ad\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/sf\d+-fe-tos\.pglstatp-toutiao\.com\/obj\/ad-pattern\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/lf-cdn-tos\.bytescm\.com\/obj\/static\/ad\//i then reject(404)


[MITM]
hostname = webcast-open.douyin.com, beta-luna.douyin.com, ether-pack.pangolin-sdk-toutiao.com, api-access.pangolin-sdk-toutiao?.com, sf*-fe-tos.pglstatp-toutiao.com, lf-cdn-tos.bytescm.com
